registration_required.quote: The Department has control of all matters pertaining to the apiary industry in this State.

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to have in the person's possession any bees kept in other than movable frame hives.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Neglected or abandoned used hives or appliances containing beeswax or bee comb, unless kept in an enclosure so constructed as to prevent access by bees, are hereby declared to be public nuisances, and it shall be unlawful to maintain them.

honey_extraction_bee_exclusion_required.quote: Any and all extracting of honey shall be done in a place to which bees cannot gain access either during or after such extracting process.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: A person shall not ship or transport into this State any queens or other bees in screened cages without comb unless the shipment is accompanied by a certificate of an authorized officer of the state of origin

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: Were inspected within 60 days before the date of shipment

combless_package_import_exemption.quote: A person shall not ship or transport into this State any queens or other bees in screened cages without comb unless the shipment is accompanied by a certificate of an authorized officer of the state of origin

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: "Disease" means any condition adversely affecting bees, or their brood, which may become epidemic, including, without limitation, bacteria, viruses or invertebrate pests and the presence of undesirable genetic characteristics including those associated with Apis mellifera scutellata or hybrids of this subspecies.

quarantine_authority.quote: Proclaim a quarantine in accordance with the provisions of chapter 554 of NRS.

inspector_disinfection_required_after_in.quote: After inspecting infected hives or fixtures, or handling diseased bees, the inspector shall, before leaving the premises or proceeding to any other apiary: 1. Thoroughly disinfect any portion of his or her own person and clothing, and any tools or appliances used by him or her which have come in contact with disease-infected material

right_of_entry_scope.quote: For the enforcement of the provisions of this chapter, inspectors shall have access to all apiaries, appliances, structures and premises where bees or their products are kept.

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: It shall be unlawful for the owner, owners, lessee, lessees, agent or caretaker of any apiary, including appliances, structures, buildings and honey, wherein disease exists, to move or distribute any diseased bees, whether they are queens or workers, colonies, honeycombs, appliances or structures beyond the already established boundaries of such apiary wherein disease exists without written permission from the Director or his or her designee.

pollination_service_colony_strength_cert.quote: Certify hives of bees used in commercial pollinization on the basis of colony strength.

inspection_fee_charged.quote: Establish reasonable fees to cover the cost of colony strength inspection and certification.
